basis: 5D PCA fitted on matched 20-token paragraph windows; line states projected after train-basis standardization; line PC coordinates centered within page-side to remove page-level state
interpretation: Paragraph entry is a multivariate latent-state transient, not merely a change in the original scalar continuity statistic. The largest displacement is on PC1, the matched near-family/local-continuity axis: entry lines are strongly negative relative to their own page state and recover by line1-3. PC3 and PC5 also shift, while PC2/PC4 effects are smaller/nonmonotone.
interpretation_cross_section: The entry-to-interior direction is strongly aligned among H/P/S/T and moderately aligned for Biological. This supports a partially shared paragraph-entry trajectory rather than wholly section-specific reset mechanisms. Biological remains a possible distinct or noisier case.
caveats: Line fingerprints are noisier than matched paragraph/page fingerprints because individual lines are short; only lines with >=5 body tokens are included.
The PCA basis was fitted using all eligible paragraph windows, so this is descriptive/development evidence, not prospective validation.
Page-centering removes static page state but does not by itself prove causality of paragraph boundaries.
next: Run grouped held-out entry/interior prediction and cross-section transfer using the frozen matched latent basis; then residualize metadata + page-local state + paragraph-relative position.
